title: Kutenda Kuseri Kwechigaro Choumambo
intro: Mimwe mweya haiedzwi nemoto kana mafashamo, asi nekumanikidzwa kunononoka kwekugara muimba yemudzvinyiriri. Munhu uyu akamira padivi pemutongi aiti ndiye mwari pamusoro pevanhu vake, asi muchivande akabatirira pakutenda muna Mwari Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi. Pakawanikwa kuzvipira kwavo, kutambura kwakauya - asi vimbiso yaMwari yakauyawo. Ungafungidzira here kuti uyu ndiani?
clues: Ndaigara pasi pedenga remutongi ane simba kupfuura vese munyika yangu, munzvimbo isingafungidzirwe nevashoma.
Mukadzi wangu akamira pamberi pevanhu akazviti mwari — asi moyo wangu waiva waIshe Mumwe Chete Wechokwadi.
Ndakanyengetera ndichizevezera muchivande, ndichitya kurangwa kwaizouya kune vese vairamba mukadzi wangu.
Kutenda kwangu pakwakafumurwa, ndakabatwa ndikatambudzwa — asi rurimi rwangu haruna kumbobvira rwataura shoko rekusatenda.
Ndakadurura mwoyo wangu kuna Ishe wangu, ndichikumbira imba muParadhiso, kure nezvakaipa zvose.
Ndini Asia bint Muzahim — mudzimai waFarao aipikisa Musa naHarun.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
